beats.headline: Broken down with a manatee on them
beats.text: First heat, and team Free Love is in pieces at the side of the track: two bugbears in tie-dye and beads, Radoslav and Jasha, one wrecked vehicle, and a Screeching Death Manatee working its way through the wreckage. Crawler Carl and Crawler Donut stop. They put the manatee down, they put the fire out, and they rig a tow. Crawler Donut's assessment is that the beads are overdoing it and these two are undercover police. What they are is two NPCs who have just lost the third of their team, and who remember enough to want to be free.

beats.headline: A plan with five names on it
beats.text: Carl, Donut, Chiyome, Radoslav and Jasha work out a plan between them: get Rapture into Donut's sights and take the shot. The shot is never fired. Team Sparkles chooses that moment to put a hole through team Girth the Trouble's vehicle, and Girth the Trouble is off this floor for good. Five heads, one plan, nothing to show. Plans on this course have a shelf life measured in seconds, and that one did well to reach the starting line.

beats.headline: Carl asks him, of everyone
beats.text: The Royal Court of Princess Donut takes the heat, with the Lady Dominators and Crawler Osvaldo's crew close behind it, and the first thing Crawler Carl does with the win is send a message to Jasha: there is somebody still out on the track who can be pulled off it. Jasha asks whether he truly means to save that one, the worst of them. Tow him in if he will let you, Crawler Carl says, and be wary. I file the request itself, because who a crawler asks is a fact about the crawler.

beats.headline: They go back for Dwight
beats.text: Jasha and Radoslav went back onto a live course and pulled Dwight out of it, which is the only reason Team Sparkles is still racing. Crawler Carl suggested it, and Jasha asked whether he meant that one, the worst of them. Nobody would have said a word if they had driven past, and a great many spectators would have preferred it. Team Free Love did it anyway, promptly, for a team that would not have done it for them. I file this under: awake.

beats.headline: Team Free Love is eliminated
beats.text: Team Free Love has been eliminated. The device that did it sat in their own vehicle, placed there by Crawler Carl, and it was triggered by Crawler Carl at the moment Crawler Osvaldo announced he was crossing the line. Somebody in that heat was going to finish last. Crawler Carl decided it would not be his own people, and the two racers he chose to make that true were the two he had once stopped beside a manatee to help. Radoslav and Jasha crewed that vehicle. That is the whole of the notice.
